newsitem.title: USA: Home Shopping sued by former host.
newsitem.headline: Home Shopping sued by former host.

text.p: Home Shopping Network faces a lawsuit by former host Mel Arthur, who alleges that he was fired in June because he was too old.
"The median age for HSN customers is 47, but HSN wants someone who looks like their grandson selling to them," Arthur, 53, said in an interview Wednesday.
Arthur, who filed his suit Tuesday, also said HSN owed him a $65,000 bonus and additional money to buy stock options.
A HSN spokesman declined to comment.
Arthur, who had worked for HSN for more than seven years, said the former management gave an employment contract last October and he routinely earned bonuses for his sales ability.
But he went to work on June 11, only to be told that HSN was buying out his contract.
New HSN boss, Barry Diller, "is a Hollywood type, and they're very age conscious ... Diller picked up the phone and fired me," Arthur said.
"They handed me a letter with my name misspelled, and a check for $168,000 and said, 'It's Mr. Diller's company, and Mr. Diller wants to go in a different direction,'" he said.
The firing was so sudden that no replacement host was available for that day's show, he claimed.
Arthur said he is drawing $250 per month in unemployment.
